name: 中毒
description: At each settle, loses HP equal to its stacks (bypasses shield), then loses 1 stack. Removed when stacks or duration reach 0.

name: 虛弱
description: Damage dealt by the afflicted unit is multiplied by 0.75, rounded down. Stacks do not change the multiplier. Duration counts down at each settle.

name: 護盾
description: Stacks absorb incoming damage. Any remaining stacks expire when the owner's next turn begins, so a shield covers the opponent's action in between.
